It will also provide the sole berth for the 2015–16 CONCACAF Champions League. The Apertura tournament will be played in the second half of 2014, while the Clausura will be played in the first half of 2015.{{cite web|url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesn/nica2015.html|title=Nicaragua 2014/2015|author=Nakor'd García|work=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|publisher=[[RSSSF]]|accessdate=2015-07-20}} ==Teams== A total of 10 teams will contest the league, including 8 sides from the [[2013–14 Primera División de Nicaragua|2013–14 season]] and one sides directly promoted from the 2013–14 Segunda division. The final participant will be determined in a two-legged play-off, in which the 9th placed Primera division side [[FC San Marcos]] will play the team who finished second in Segunda division which was [[Fox Villa]]. [[Fox Villa]] won 2-0 over [[FC San Marcos]] gaining promotion. {{colbegin}} * [[ART Municipal Jalapa|ART Jalapa]] * [[Diriangén FC]] * [[Juventus Managua|UCEM Juventus FC]] * [[Managua F.C.]] * [[Deportivo Ocotal]] * [[Real Madriz]] * [[Real Esteli F.C.]] * [[Fox Villa]] (Winner of the relegation/promotion playoff) * [[UNAN Managua]] (Winner of the Segunda Division) * [[Deportivo Walter Ferretti|Walter Ferretti]] {{colend}} ===Promotion and relegation=== * At the end of the [[2013–14 Primera División de Nicaragua|2013–14]], [[UNAN Managua]] and [[Fox Villa]] were promoted to Primera Division * At the end of the [[2013–14 Primera División de Nicaragua|2013–14]], [[Chinandega FC]] and [[FC San Marcos]] were relegated to Segunda Division. ===Changes=== * Juventus Managua changed their name and will now be known as UCEM Juventus FC [] ===Stadiums and locations=== ==Team information== ''Last updated: 2014'' === Personnel and sponsoring (2014 Apertura) === {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
